rate_source: fx.csv; rate = units of target_currency per 1 unit of source_currency
rate_date_rule: calendar date of the transaction instant in the company timezone (manifest.timezone); if fx.csv has no rate for that date, use the latest earlier date
ar_credit_rule: AR is credited for each invoice_ref at the invoice's policy rate; difference with the cash debit is posted to fx_gain_loss
unreferenced_payments: payments with invoice_refs = null are posted to unapplied_cash; negative amount = refund (debit unapplied_cash, credit cash)
period_boundary: an event belongs to the period iff period_start <= instant < period_end (instants compared with their offsets)

rounding.stage: once per converted document total or per invoice_ref allocation

money: integer minor units; exponent per currency in manifest.currency_exponents
ledger_currency: all ledger rows are in base currency

reporting.claimed_amount_minor: absolute misstatement in base-currency minor units

evidence_ids.rule: ids of records that together prove the finding: doc_id, ledger row_id, fx rate key 'DATE:SRC:TGT' (the rate the policy prescribes); max 10; supersets of existing ids are fine, an id that does not exist makes the finding unmatched
evidence_ids.duplicate_invoice: doc_id of the original + doc_id of the later copy + the copy's AR (or revenue) row_id
evidence_ids.payment_allocation: payment doc_id + invoice doc_id + the payment's unapplied_cash row_id + the AR credit row_id if any part was credited + fx key of the invoice policy rate if the invoice is in foreign currency
evidence_ids.fx_conversion: document doc_id + its AR/revenue (invoice) or cash (payment) row_id + fx key of the policy rate
evidence_ids.period_cutoff: invoice doc_id + its AR (or revenue) row_id

tolerance.rule: exact: |claimed - true amount| <= amount_minor (minor units); ids, type and currency are compared as exact strings; every evidence id must exist
